items.title: 23.1 Drug discovery and development process (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of pharmacology and drug discovery (PDF 208).

blocks.text: Pharmacology hayatiyat ki woh shaakh hai jo dawaon aur jandaron par un ke asraat ka mutala karti hai: un ke zaraye, khasiyatein, tarkeeb, ilaaj mein istemal aur jism par asar. Dawaen kimiyai maadde hain jo bimariyon ki tashkhees, bachao ya ilaaj mein use hote hain. Yeh qudrati zaraye, paudon, janwaron aur khurdbeeni jandaron, se aa sakti ya laboratories mein banayi ja sakti hain; paudon se bani dawaen, jo riwayati tareeqa-e-ilaaj mein use hoti hain, jari booti ki dawaen (phytotherapy) kehlati hain.

Drug discovery aur drug development mehfooz aur mo'assar dawaen banate hain. Amal bimari paida karne wale targets ki pehchan aur un par asar karne wale compounds banane se shuru hota hai. Awaam ke liye manzoori se pehle dawa hifazat, asar aur miyaar ke kai marhalon ki jaanch se guzarti hai, aur sciencedan, mahireen aur regulatory idare saath kaam karte hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar panel, drug discovery: chaar neele dabbe, 1 target ki pehchan, 2 target ki tasdeeq, 3 lead compound ki pehchan, 4 lead ki behtari. Neeche panel, drug development: cells aur janwaron mein preclinical tehqeeq, clinical trial phase 1 (20-100 sehatmand log), 2 (100-300 mareez) aur 3 (1,000-3,000), phir regulatory review, banana aur bechna, aur market ke baad nigrani.
blocks.caption: Bimari ke target se manzoor dawa tak (topic 23.1 ke liye asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Nayi dawa drug discovery se shuru hoti hai: sciencedan target molecule pehchante hain, jaise bimari mein shamil protein ya enzyme; tasdeeq karte hain ke is par asar se bimari ka ilaaj ho sakta hai; hazaron qudrati ya masnooi compounds mein se umeed afza lead compounds chunte hain; aur leads ko zyada mo'assar aur kam zehreela banate hain. Phir development dawa ko test karta hai: cell cultures (in vitro) aur janwaron (in vivo) mein preclinical tehqeeq, phir insanon par clinical trials, phase 1 mein 20-100 sehatmand razakaron par hifazat aur khurak, phase 2 mein 100-300 mareezon par asar aur zimni asraat, aur phase 3 mein 1,000-3,000 logon par asar ki tasdeeq aur nuqsandeh rad-e-amal ki nigrani. Regulators sab data jaanchte, manzoor dawa banti aur bikti hai, aur market ke baad kam milne wale aur lambe asraat ke liye nigrani hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Dawa ke qudrati aur masnooi zariye mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Qudrati dawaen paudon, janwaron ya khurdbeeni jandaron se aati hain; masnooi dawaen laboratories mein kimiyai tayyari se banti hain.
